reviews.t: WHERE HAS THIS MASCARA BEEN ALL MY LIFE?!?!
reviews.x: This review is for the I 🖤 Extreme Volume WATERPROOF Mascara (Blue Tube). This mascara is INCREDIBLE! I’ve been in a mascara rut lately. I don’t have the best lashes… they’re only maybe average in length… on a good day… and they don’t hold a curl very well at all! I normally don’t like waterproof mascara because it’s so difficult to remove and usually gets clumpy so quickly and has a tendency to be pretty sticky and not build that well… HOWEVER, I live in the south where it is normally always VE

The bottle is bigger than i thought which is NOT a bad thing (compared it to a normal sized q-tip). This mascara is AMAZING, after just 2 coats it gave my lashes amazing volume and the mascara didn’t clump at all. I compared it to the lash princess false lash effect (also by essence) that i’ve been using and it’s definitely better in my opinion. I also rubbed my eye with water to test the waterproof part of the mascara, a few tiny flakes of mascara came off but not a terrible difference. I’m pre

reviews.t: I wanted to love this mascara
reviews.x: Everyone raves about Essence, so I had to try it. My lashes don’t hold a curl, so I needed a waterproof product. They offer very few waterproof options. This one had good reviews so I chose it. My first issue was the size of the brush. It’s huge. I have never seen a brush that large before. It is definitely not made for precision. I knew I’d end up with a mess, but I tried it anyway. It glides on nicely but the wand was hard to use. Also, zero curl hold. I always curl my lashes for 30 seconds th

reviews.t: Hidden gem! Better than any mascara I've tried!
reviews.x: OMG I love this mascara! Why has no one talked about this mascara before I've never heard of it before I found it that's less than $5 that's also waterproof & vegan & cruelty free & actually keeps my lashes curled!! ! It's freaking amazing!! The tube is huge way bigger than most normal mascara tubes & probably one of the best mascaras I've ever tried & I've tried everything of almost every price range I freaking love it & had to share!! essence | I Love Extreme Volume...

I didn't like anything about this mascara. The brush was so thick and full of mascara that I could barley get it on my eyelashes without having mascara all over my face around my eyes!!! The mascara formula was so thick that it made my eyelashes stuck together, no separation whatsoever. And the clumps, OMG THE CLUMPS!!!! Horrible, just horrible... In the trash and $5 wasted!!! Do not buy  Update I also wrote an email to this company sharing my experience with this product and the company has not

I normally use L’Oréal Voluminous waterproof mascara and prefer the softness of their natural bristles. I cannot use those rubber bristle wands. This Essence wand has natural type bristles but they are HUGE. I think this help deposit lots of mascara but I also tend to get some on my skin. Now I wipe the wand on a tissue before using which works much better.

Overall, I’m obsessed with this mascara. It makes my eye lashes HUGE and spidery, which I love. The reason I only gave it three stars is because throughout the day, it would start to flake off onto my face. If they were able to fix that issue, this mascara would be perfect!

Looks beautiful after application and dries pretty quick.  In less than two hours in an air conditioned environment it runs. With a primer, without primer and a coat of clear after applying it still gives me raccoon eyes.

I've been using the same mascara for the last 10 years but didn't want to spend $10 again to get another two. I decided to give this mascara a try and I'm really glad I did. I put it on pretty close to bedtime and had a doctor's appointment the next day. I woke up very late and had 20 minutes to get to the doctor's office I looked in the mirror and the mascara was still perfectly in place, definitely saved me a lot of time at morning. I really like it and I will buy it again.
Bought for a beach/pool trip. Pleased with ease of going on & volume. Stayed on when swimming & face sweating lol. I removed any mascara & makeup with coconut oil.  Will buy again.
It’s a really good mascara. The application is quite messy though (for me) but it’s nothing a good ole q-tip can’t fix. It is waterproof and will last the whole day.
Amazing! This is the best mascara I’ve ever had, I can’t believe it’s so cheap. My eyelashes look FAKE.

reviews.t: Thick and luscious lashes for a bargain price
reviews.x: This is a fantastic product that outperforms mascara that costs a lot more. It made my lashes look thick (the volume!!!) and longer without having to put on lots of coats or try to curl them. This is now my go to mascara. I prefer it over expensive department  store brands. I also like that they don't test on animals.

reviews.t: Goes on nicely,  but doesn't stay on
reviews.x: I only use waterproof mascara,  as I have longer lashes and others give me raccoon eyes.  This mascara went on very well and looked great for a short time,  but soon itof my lashes and on my fragile under-eye skin.  I could not get it off,  so I had to go around for the rest of the day looking like a raccoon.  😠

My eyes are very sensitive to fumes and water oftentimes. I don't experience any problems with the waterproof mascara. The only problem I find is it's a very full tip. I usually need to touch up my skin with a Qtip after.
Love this mascara. It goes on really well and easily, and stays all day in water. I wore it on beach vacation and had no running at all. Definitely recommend.
Big brush but didn’t pack volume or length. Flakes quite a bit but doesn’t smudge. Not “extreme” in any sense. Just basic mascara. Wouldn’t buy again.
Does not clump adds a good amount of volume. Lashes stay separate. Wears well does not run easily.
Hard to remove, but looks good and it is definitely waterproof.

reviews.t: My new favorite mascara / no packaging?
reviews.x: UPDATE: Same product as reviewed previously (below), but my latest order from Amazon came without shrink-wrap/tamper-resistant packaging of any sort. Not sure I’ll reorder? Strangely, the other Essence mascara (different variety) in the same order came shrink-wrapped. This is my new favorite mascara! Doesn’t clump, has a nice wand, and best of all, it doesn’t give me raccoon eyes in the summer humidity. Price can’t be beat, either! Bought a tube for my mom to try. My usual makeup remover cleans

It's hard to find a basic, waterproof vegan mascara that doesn't have a ridiculous brush or a crazy price tag. This one is great. The wand is super big, like the size of BeneFit's original Bad Gal, which took some getting used to for me. But I'll say this formula is excellent - it goes on clump-free and is definitely lengthening and volumizing, and it has proved to definitely be waterproof. I haven't swam with it or anything, but if you wear this mascara while watching The Notebook, you'll emerg

Love the length it provides without going to a fiber mascara (fiber is so difficult to separate lashes before it dries).  It does get clumpy after the tube is used for about 2 weeks, so I use a clean mascara wand to clear the clumps, after I apply it.  The waterproof is good but bottom lashes tend to wear off, likely due to the make-up I use. Due to how light my lashes are, I need to apply on both sides of my upper lashes.  It's still one of the best mascaras I've ever used.

Tried it for a week. It barely does anything for volume, and I couldn't make it 20 minutes after application before it started crumbling and getting into my eyes. It just existed by my eyeballs and chose violence.  I specifically get waterproof makeup in case something happens and I cry, and this didn't hold up. I went from crying from a real injury to crying from this crud getting into my eyes. Do not buy this.

reviews.t: I like it. Needs primer to add extra volume
reviews.x: I like it. It doesn't add much volume as I expected, but still it's great mascara. Pro: Water proof, no smudge,  no clump, last long time. Bold black. Add some volume. It's water proof but gentle enough not burning my eyes. Cruelty free. Affordable price (it was $4.99 when I purchased January 2019). Con: It doesn't add much volume as I expected, it needs primer to add extra volume.

This is the best mascara I've ever used and I've used hundreds!! I'm finally satisfied with a mascara that gives me just the look I need, the volume can build up by layers and it's not so fast to dry so you can build as much as you love, in the picture showed I used only one layer and it's incredibly awesome. Essence never let me down, a huge recommend🥰

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the mascara for delivering dramatic volume and thick, full lashes.
Many reviewers find the brush/wand too large, causing messy application and mascara getting on the skin around the eyes.
Several reviewers report that despite being waterproof, the mascara runs, flakes, or smudges onto the face during the day.
Multiple reviewers highlight the low price and value, saying it outperforms more expensive brands.
Some reviewers praise its waterproof staying power, noting it lasts through swimming, sweating, and long days.
